lines.text: God tells Jonah son of Amittai to preach against Nineveh, but Jonah flees from the LORD on a ship bound for Tarshish.
Jonah goes down to Gath, finds a ship, pays the fare, and sails away from the presence of the LORD.
The LORD hurls a great wind upon the sea, and the frightened sailors throw the ship's cargo into the sea.
The sailors cast lots, the lot falls on Jonah, and he says he worships the LORD, the God who made the sea and the dry land.
Jonah tells the sailors to cast him into the sea, but they first tie him to the mast and row hard.

wrong_details.true: row hard to get back to dry land
